tei:div.tei:p: "$ (147)༄༅// ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i chos drug gi khrid kyi gnad yig snying po kun 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(148)༄༅// na mo lo ker shwa rā ya/ gang zhig brjod bral lhun grub 'dus ma byas// kha sbyor bde chen longs sku gang 'dul shar// sku gsum bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang la sogs// rje mkhyen pas gzigs shig drin chen bla ma rnams// thugs brtse bas dgongs shig yi dam lha yi tshogs// dus 'bral bar med par skyongs shig dkon mchog gsum// 'gal rkyen spongs la mthun rkyen sgrubs shig mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// thang stong gi rgyal po// lung stong gi smyon pa/ zas gang byung gi bcud len po// rkyen gang byung gi ro snyoms po ngas theg pa chen po'i chos thams cad kyi nying khu phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa khyad par can 'di 'chad pa la/ nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag dang*/ nyams len dngos gnyis kyi dang po ni rgyud sde lnga'am/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi thob cing*/ dam tshig dang dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor (149)ba'i nyes dmigs sogs sngon 'gro'i chos rnams rgyud la skyes pa zhig dgos te/ ni gu ma'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang las// dbang bzhis smin byas dad dang brtson 'grus ldan// mi rtag skyo shas nyes dmigs sngon 'gro ba'i/ lam mchog 'di la gang gis 'bad gyur na// zla drug lo'am tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'gyur// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa nyams len dngos la// sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer 'bum dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du dar zab la sogs pa'i gdan sna tshogs pa'i steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ (150)sku gcer bu la rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra sil bu sku rked yan chad khebs pa/ sku mthong ba tsam gyis sdig sgrib 'dags pa/ gsung thos pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god nges pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa zhig bsams la/ de'i mdun du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis snying gi dkyil rkang gi khongs nas skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= yi dam la skyabs su mchi'o/ dpe gcig la 'di 'dug pa brtag /mchan/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs brjod/ de nas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bde sdug nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor gyi rim pa la 'jug par bgyi'o// zhes sems bskyed/ de nas bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ mkha' 'gro ni gu ma la= grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor la= rmog lcog rin chen brtson 'grus la gsol= mnyam med skyer sgang pa chen po la= bla ma sangs rgyas gnyan ston la= chos rjes sangs rgyas ston pa la= mkhas grub shangs ston chos rje la= rgyal ba mus pa chen po la= bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la= mtshan ldan nam (151)mkha'i rnal 'byor la/

byang sems sbyin pa bzang po la= grub thob brtson 'grus bzang po la= thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar du byin gyis rlobs/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol tu= rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag tu= 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs su= 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas su= bar do rgyal ba longs sku ru byin gyis rlobs// zhes sam/ tshigs su bcad pa gang rung gis gsol ba drag tu gdab par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la drug ste/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag /'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku'o// dang po thabs lam la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// dang po la gsum ste/ dag byed a'i stong ra/ stong ra nad gdon sel byed/ rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par ro// dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po rgyan cha lugs gong dang 'dra bar bsgoms te/ de la bla ma yi dam thams cad bstims la/ bla ma rin po che bdag gi nad gdon zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ sdig sgrib 'dags par byin gyis rlobs/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gsol ba btab/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar srid pa'i dbang zhus nas ngag tu a zhes brjod pas rang gi smin mtshams dang rna ba g.yas g.yon tu zur re re gtad pa'i chos 'byung phyi dkar nang dkar stong sang nge ba lus dang mnyam pa zhig bsam mo// de ltar ma yengs par yang yang du bsgoms pas sdig sgrib dkor sku glud dam tshig gi nyams chags thams cad dag go /gnyis pa stong ra nad gdon (152)sel byed ni/ rang gi os ko dang rna ba'i rtsa ba gnyis su zur re re gtad pa'i chos 'byung phyi nang gnyis ka dkar ba rtsa ba gsang gnas su zug pa'i nang du sems skye med a dmar po zhig bsam/

ngag tu a a zhes ci rigs brjod pas a de 'od du zhu nas ngo bo bdud rtsi rnam pa ga bur ltar dkar ba reg bya bsil ba/ tsha ba'i nang thams cad zhi par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa zhig bsam/ yang rang gi nu ma gnyis de'i thad kar sgral tshigs dang gsum la zur re re gtad pa'i chos 'byung phyi nang gnyis ka dmar po'i nang du rang sems skye med a dmar po zhig bsam/ yang gong bzhin brjod pas a de zhu nas ngo bo bdud rtsi rnam pa zangs zhun ltar dmar ba reg bya tsha ba grang ba'i nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa zhig bsgom/ yang rang gi lte ba dang mkhal khung gnyis la zur re re gtad pa'i chos 'byung phyi nang gnyis ka smug po'i nang du rang sems a smug po zhig bsam/ ngag tu sngar bzhin brjod pas a de 'od du zhu nas ngo bo bdud rtsi rnam pa mar zhu ba'i dngas ma ltar smug pa/ reg bya 'jam pa/ rlung gi nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ yang rang gi lte 'og sor bzhi dang dpyi mgo gnyis la zur re re gtad pa'i/ chos 'byung nag po'i nang du rang sems a nag po zhig bsam/ de la sngar bzhin brjod pas/ a de zhu nas ngo bo bdud rtsi rnam pa khro chu ltar khol ba reg bya shin tu tsha ba/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sreg pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa zhig bsams nas/ ngag tu a zhes brjod pas nad thams cad sngo dmar gyi rnam pa/ gdon thams cad sdig sprul sogs dang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad rnag khrag dang dud khu'i rnam pas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad dang*/ 'og sgo nas 'thon cing nang du yang tshag chom chom sreg par bsgom mo// 'di rnams rgyun du ma yengs (153)par bsgoms pas gang la dmigs pa'i nad gdon thams cad zhi bar myong bas grub bo// yang na chos 'byung snga ma snga ma'i nang du/ phyi ma phyi ma rnams bsgoms kyang rung ngo*// gsum pa rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par ni/

nyi zla shar ba/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ khang steng dang gangs ri sogs ri bo'i rtser phyin pa/ chur mi bying bar phyin pa/ ngo tsha ba'i rtog pa med pa gcer bu 'thon pa/ khrus byas pa/ gos dkar po dri ma med pa gon pa sogs ni sdig pa 'dag pa'i rtags so// 'khru skyugs dang rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang*/ lus la rdul mang po 'thon pa ni nad thon pa'i rtags so// sdig sbrul sdom sbal lcong 'bu srin thon pa ni gdon thon pa'i rtags so// de rnams dngos sam nyams snang ngam rmi lam sogs ci rigs su 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga ste/ lus gnad me'i stong ra'am dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ gtum mo gos su gyon pa/ zas su za ba/ gdan du bting ba/ srid pa'i dbang zhu ba'o// dang po ni rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus tsog pu byas/ rkang pa gnyis bsnol ba'i mthil stan la gtad/ lag pa gnyis bsnol nas lhu ba g.yas g.yon gnyis la 'jus/ gru mo pus mo la bkal/ mgrin pa cung zad sgu bar byed pa'i me thab drug chings byas la spyi bor bla ma sdar bzhin bsgom/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces brjod/ srid pa'i dbang zhus nas/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas gsang gnas kyi bar rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug ltar drang ba/ dong rtse ltar khog stong pa/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar ba/ til gyi zhun mar ltar dngas pa ste dbu ma chos bzhi ldan gsal gdab/ de'i g.yas na ro ma dmar po/ (154)g.yon na rkyang ma dkar mo// de gnyis kyi mas sna dbu ma'i nang du chud pa/ lte ba snying kha mgrin pa spyi bo ste gnas bzhir ro rkyang gnyis 'khril ba'i rtsa mdud re re yod pa/ spyi bo nas g.yas su ro ma g.yon du rkyang ma la rtsa phran bzhi bzhi gyes pa kha'i g.yas g.yon gnyis/ sna bug gnyis mig gnyis rna ba gnyis po rnams su sbrul mgo ltar tsheg ge yod pa/

bshang lam kyi sgor rlung gi mda' gzhu mchog ma la ba dan sngon po 'phyangs pa/ mde rtse ro rkyang gnyis kyi bar gyi dbu ma'i nang du chud pa/ mde'u'i rtser raṃ las me gla ba'i ril ma tsam rtsa ba phra ba/ rtse mo rno ba/ rked pa ldir ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ kha dog dmar ba ste chos lnga ldan gsal gdab/ spyi gtsug gi dbu ma'i nang du haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo mthur la lta ba bsam/ de nas rlung ro dal bus phyir bsal nas/ rlung mnyam rgyur byas te steng rlung dal bus nang du mar drang*/ 'og rlung dal bus yar 'then la steng 'og gi rlung lte bar kha sbyar bas/ 'og gi rlung g.yos pas me de gzug mo byi thur gyi dbyibs 'dra ba zhig lte 'og tu 'bar/ yang rlung bzung nas lte bar 'bar/ rlung 'dzin thengs gsum pa la snying gar slebs pa'i drod kyis spyi bo'i haṃ yig las thig le mu tig gi phreng ba lta bur babs/ snying ga'i me la phog bas sor sgra dang bcas pa bsam/ me ma shi ba dang me lce ma 'dar bar byed pa zab gnad gcig yin pas gal che'o// des thog mar drod skye/ de nas bde ba/ de nas bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur bas chos drug gi rtsa ba lta bu yin no// 'di yang ni gu mas// rang lus thabs ldan rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// a haṃ 'bar 'dzag skad cig dga' bzhis brgyan// shes rab kha kha mu kha'i snyoms 'jug gis// zag bcas zag med dga' bzhi rim bzhin no/ zhes pas bstan to// gnyis pa gtum mo gos su gyon pa ni/ (155)lus gnad dang dmigs pa sngar bzhin las lag pa bsnol ba'i mthil gnyis mkhal ma g.yas g.yon la bkab la/ lte ba dang de'i thad kyi rgyab mkhal ma g.yas g.yon gnyis su me cog sgong tsam bzhi bsams la sngar bzhin rlung kha sbyor bzung bas drod myur du skye ba myong bas grub bo// na so rgas po yin na me phug ron gyi sgo nga'am ngang pa'i sgo nga tsam bsam mo// gsum pa gtum mo zas su za ba ni/

lus gnad gong bzhin la sngar gyi dmigs pa'i steng du chu rlung dkar po bus/ me rlung dmar po bzung ste rlung kha sbyar bas/ ༈ rkan nas me 'jigs rtags gnyis bar dpe gcig la mi snang*/ mchan/ su rung ba zhig babs pas/ ༈ lto ba'i nang thams cad mes dmar mer gang bar bsgom mo// de la gegs 'byung nye bas myong ba dang sbyar na/ dang po rlung gi rlung bus/ de nas me rlung bus/ de nas rlung rnams 'og nas 'byung ba'i kha dog ltar bus nas/ de nas sa rlung ser po so rtsa nas bzung bar dmigs la lte 'og gi rlung nang du drangs te kha sbyar bas lto pa ser mer gang bar bsam/ de nas chu rlung dkar po ya rkan nas bzung bas dkar mer gang*/ me rlung dmar po so bar nas bzung bas dmar mer gang*/ de nas rlung rlung sngon po bzung ste steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor bas lto ba sngo mer gang bar bsgom/ des drod myur zhing gegs chung ngo*// bzhi pa gtum mo gdan du bting ba ni/ lus gnad dang dmigs pa gong bzhin gyi steng du/ nyal ba'i tshe khyi nyal sgor mor bya/ gzhog g.yas 'og tu bcug ste nyal la rlung phyir phyung ba dang*/ sna nas me dmar nar byung bas mal sbug thams cad mes dmar mer gang bar bsams la/ rlung cung zad bzung nas bsgom mo// lnga pa srid pa'i dbang bskur zhu ba ni spyi bor bla ma sngar bzhin bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi rnam (156)bar spyan drangs la bstim/ kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la lus longs spyod thams cad mchod pa phul la/ bla ma rin po che bdag la srid pa'i dbang bskur bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i zhabs kyi mthe bong las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung*/ smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku mngon du byas par bsam/

bdud rtsi dmar po byung*/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du byas/ bdud rtsi sngon po byung*/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byas par bsam/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med par gyur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam spros bral bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi mngon du byas par bsam mo// des sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag /gegs mi 'byung*/ ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa skye/ skyes pa rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa rjes la gnyis las/ dang po gegs rang grol ni/ nu ma gnyis de'i dbus te gsum dang de gsum gyi thad ka'i rgyab tu khro bo'i mig shin tu 'jigs pa gsum bsam/ lus kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khrol ma'i mig gam tshags se'i mig lta bu bsgom/ de'i mig rnams nas nad thams cad sngo dmar dang*/ gdon thams cad sdig sbrul dang sbal lcong sogs dang*/ (157)sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'i rnam pas tshags se'i nang nas chu tshags pa bzhin bud par bsams la kha sbyor bzung ngo*// smad du kun+da'i gegs byung na 'khrul 'khor dang dbab bzung zlog dgram gyi dmigs pas bsal lo// rjes kyi gnyis pa rlung rtar zhon pa'i man ngag ni/ rang gi mchan khung gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis su/ rlung gi bya mo sngon mo re re bsam mo// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gzhag 'og tu gzhug /gtso bor sa rlung phyir bus/ rlung rlung nang du bzung ste/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyor te gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa la bskor bar bsam mo// rlung 'byangs nas 'gro ba'i tshe bya mo bzhis nam mkha' la 'khyer bar bsam ste/

rlung bzung nas phyin na rta me chog dang 'dra ba'i 'gros 'byung ngo*// 'di rnams kyang ni gums// bcud pa sdus dag byed stong ra'i gnad gsum dang*// drod myur gtum mo'i chos drug rim bzhin te// ri bong dbab bzung zlog dgram rlung dang bsre// gnyis med ye shes chen pos brgyan par bya// zhes pas bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol la gsum ste/ dbang po rab bla ma dam pa grogs su bsten pa/ 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod bar 'khrid pa/ tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'o// dang po ni sngon 'gro sngar bzhin byas nas/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung sku gcer bu la rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa// zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa dbu skra sil bus sku phyed yan chad khebs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ 'od zer 'phro bas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlobs bzhin pa (158)zhig bsams la/ de'i mdun du bdag gis byang drangs pa bzhin du sems can thams cad kyang ku di ri ri gsol ba 'debs par bsams la/ bla ma rin po che bdag med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ bdag 'dzin thong bar= sgyu lus 'byongs par= /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mngon du 'gyur bar= zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab cing*/ bla ma rin po che bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba gdab pas/ gong thabs lam ltar dbang bskur bas mthar rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med pa'i ngang du yun ring du mnyam par bzhag go /de las ldangs pa'i spyod lam thams cad dang*/ sems la ci snang thams cad la/ a snang ni snang*/

bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin ang snyam du bsam mo// gsol 'debs bla ma'i lam khyer dang*/ ci snang bden med lam khyer gnyis gsungs pa'ang 'di kho na la 'dus pa yin no// rdo rje theg pa'i lam rnams kyi gtso bo 'di kho na yin pas/ 'di la 'bad cing rtse gcig tu nyams su blangs na/ lam thams cad myur du bgrod pa yin te ye shes mngon byung las// sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams// bla ma'i mos gus lo zlas bgrod// bla ma'i snang ba ma bral na// sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral med gnas// zhes dang*/ ni gu mas// lam lda sa bcu'i rim pa rnams// mos gus stobs kyis bgrod par byed// bla ma'i snang ba mi 'bral ba// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /ces gsungs so// gnyis pa dbang po 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par 'khrid pa ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngar bzhin byas la/ e ma sngar skyes pa'i sems can thams cad kyang 'chi/ da skye ba'i sems can thams cad kyang 'chi/ da lta ba'i sems can thams cad kyang mi 'chi bar tshe thar du (159)lus pa gcig kyang med pas/ nga yang nges par 'chi/ da yang 'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med pas 'chi ba'i rkyen mang*/ 'tsho ba'i rkyen nyung bas myur du 'chi ba yin ang snyam du bsams pas/ tshe 'di'i mtho dman gang la yang bsgrub 'dod kyi blo mi 'jug pa zhig nam byung byung gi bar du bsgom/ de nas shi bas ci lto snyam na shi ba'i 'og tu med par mi 'gro// gnas lugs kyi don cig ma rtogs par shi na/ rigs drug gi grong khyer drug po gang rung las 'gro sa med/ de rnams gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi longs spyod 'ba' zhig la spyod pa ma gtogs bde ba'i skabs ye med pas skyid pa mi 'dug ang snyam du bsam zhing*/ sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa zhig nam skye bar du bsgom/ a 'di thams cad rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin snyam pa'i dran 'dun yang dang yang du bsgom mo// de nas paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/

hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dkar po// rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ snang ngo na gzugs su grub pa/ thogs bcas gyi gzugs su ma grub pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu zhig bsgom/ de la lha yi sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs bzhugs tshul gyi rnam pa 'di 'dra ba rang gi blos bkod pa ma gtogs phyi rol du grub pa mi 'dug pas 'di 'dra ba 'di snang ni snang*/ bden ni mi bden rmi lam yin/ sgyu ma yin snyam du bsam zhing*/ gzhan yang sems kyi yul du snod bcud nye ring bar ma dga' sdug la sogs pa'i snang ba ci byung yang*/ long gtam sogs tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par/ ngag tu sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin zhes brjod cing*/ yid (160)la'ang sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dran 'dun ye ma nyams par bya'o// rang lus snang stong lha sku dang*/ ci snang sgyu mar la 'khyer gnyis gsungs pa'ang 'di kho na la 'dus pa yin no/ khye'u rab snang gis zhus pa'i mdo las// chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam zhes// gang gi tshig brjod dran gyur na// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas// tshe 'di nyid du 'tshang rgya nges// zhes gsungs so// de rnams la'ang myong ba re ma skyes na dbang po tha mar song ba yin pas/ gsum pa dbang po tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin skye ba na/ sngon 'gro rnams gong bzhin byas/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i lte ba'i 'og tu chos 'byung mas yar rim pa bzhin du/ nag po/ ser po/ dmar ljang*/ dmar nag /dmar po/ dkar po rnams kyi nang du rim bzhin/ dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ mi/ lha ma yin/ lha rnams bsgom/ de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas 'di thams cad sgyu ma yin rmi lam yin snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod/

snang ba thams cad bden med sgyu mar nam song bar du mal gyi drod ma yal bar byas la gzhi gcig tu bsgom mo// gzhan yang nad gdon la sogs pa'i gnod pa'am/ bde ba skyid pa la sogs pa'i snang ba ci byung yang sgyu ma yin rmi lam yin ces brjod cing bsams pas/ rigs drug skyu mar 'char byed dang*/ nad gdon sgyu ma'i lam khyer dang*/ 'char byed yon tan tshogs drug dang*/ zhen med sgyu ma rang shar rnams 'di kho na las 'byung ngo*// bsgoms pas shes so// bsdu na chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gcig gi nang du rigs drug bsgoms nas sngar bzhin bsams pas sgyu ma rang shar gyi yon tan rnams 'byung ngo*// de rnams ni ni gu mas// sgyu lus bden med dbang po rab 'bring gsum// 'bral med mos gus rang lus cir snang kun// snang stong zhen bral lha sku lam (161)khyer bya// chags sdang rang grol bcu bzhi'i sa thob 'gyur// ces gsungs pa'i nyams len gyi zhal gdams so// yang ni gu mas/ gang gi bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad la 'bral med bya// nying 'khrul rang dag sgyu ma lam khyer gyi// yon tan rang shar nyin mtshan dus su 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa'i snyan brgyud rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag la don drug ste/ rmi lam bzung ba/ sbyang ba/ spel ba/ sprul pa/ bsgyur ba/ yul snang blta ba'o// dang po rmi lam bzung ba la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni sngon 'gro gzhan rnams gong dang 'dra ba las/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ rgyan cha lugs gong dang 'dra ba zhig bsgoms nas/ bla ma rin po che bdag gis rmi lam zin par byin gyis rlobs/ rmi lam 'byongs par= rmi lam spel bar=

rmi lam sprul par= rmi lam bsgyur bar= yul snang blta bar byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gsol ba gdab cing*/ bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las oṃ dkar po byung*/ rang gi dpral bar thim pas/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas āḥdamar po byung*/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ sngon po byung*/ rang gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum (162)dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med pa'i ngang la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag /lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku bzhi mngon du byas par bsam mo// 'di rmi lam sogs chos drug gi sngon du bya'o// gnyis pa rmi lam bzung ba'i dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ rang zin dang*/ 'chugs med gnyis so// dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor haṃ yig las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig byung nas snying gar slebs/ gsang gnas nas thig le dmar po sran ma tsam zhig yar byung nas snying gar slebs/ de nas thig le dmar po des dkar po de ded de/ snying gar khra kho ro ro 'khor ba la sems gtad/ rmi lam sgyu ma'i dran 'dun bya// de ltar thig le 'khor ba bum dbang*/ reg la khad pa gsang dbang*/ reg pa shes rab ye shes dbang*/ gcig la gcig thim nas 'od du yal te mi dmigs par song bar bsam pa ni dbang bzhi pa'o// de ltar yang nas yang du bsgom zhing gnyid du 'gro khar thig le gcig la gcig thim nas yal te song ba'i mi rtog ba'i ngang la rmi lam bzung ngo*// zin pa'i tshul ni/

gnyid thum phras mang po 'byung*/ de nas 'jam zin rtsub zin gang rung gis/ a 'di rmi lam du 'dug snyam du zin pa 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa 'chugs med la don dgur mdzad kyang bsdu na gsum du 'dus te/ lus gnad/ dus gnad/ dmigs pa'i gnad do// dang po ni lus gnad tsog bu'o// gnyis pa dus gnad ni skya rings shar nas nyi ma ma shar gyi bar ro// gsum pa dmigs pa'i gnad la gsum ste/ rtog med gnyis dang*/ rtog bcas gcig go /rtog med la 'dzin pa'i dang po ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug gi haṃ las thig le dkar po mar byung*/ gsang gnas nas thig le dmar po yar byung snying khar 'phrad/ thig le gnyis sngar bzhin 'phros 'ded kyi tshul gyis 'khor ba la sems (163)gtad/ a nga gnyid du song 'dug /'di rmi lam du 'dug snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag po bya'o// gnyid du 'gro khar thig le dkar po de sna bug g.yas nas thon/ dmar po de sna bug g.yon nas smin mtshams su khra kho ro ro 'khor ba la sems gtad/ sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dran 'dun bya/ de nas thig le dkar po de 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dmar po de yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin bar song nas/ kho ro ro 'khor ba la sems gtad/ 'di sgyu ma yin/ 'di rmi lam yin snyam du bsam/ mthar yum yab la thim/ yab 'od du yal nas mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnyid log nas rmi lam bzung ngo*// rtog med la 'dzin pa'i gnyis pa ni/ dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa 'di/ bsal bya glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa zhig yin zhes brjod la/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i snying gar pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo sdom pa mtshon gang ba 'od zer 'phro ba zhig bsam la nga gnyid du song 'dug /'di rmi lam du 'dug snyam du bsam/ gnyid log khar rang nyid snying ga'i 'khor lo sdom pa la thim/

de yang 'od du yal song ste mi dmigs pa'i ngang du rmi lam bzung*/ gsum pa rtog bcas la bzung ba ni/ rmi lam gyi lus tsog pu/ dus skya rengs shar nas nyi ma ma shar gyi bar/ rmi lam gyi rgyu ni yi ge haṃ/ rmi lam gyi gnad ni mgrin pa yin pas/ rang gi mgrin par yi ge haṃ dkar po 'od 'phro ba zhig bsams la/ rmi lam gyi ngo bo ni gnyid du song ma song gi bar gyi rnam par rtog pa yin pas/ gnyid du song nas rmi lam rags pa ma shar gyi bar der mi la sogs pa'i rnam rtog rab rib shar ba de dran pas bzung ste mig mi 'byed par 'di rmi lam du 'dug snyam du ngos bzung bas rmi lam mi zin mi srid do// des kyang ye ma zin na spyi bor thod pa'i (164)nang gi klad rgya'i steng du rdo rje bdag med ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa/ nam mkha' la lding ba 'dra ba zhig bsgom/ des mi zin mi srid do// 'di rgyun du byas na gegs che bas bzhag go /gnyis pa rmi lam sbyang ba la bzhi ste/ lus kyis sems sbyong ba/ sems kyis lus sbyong ba/ bdag med mas sbyong ba/ 'dun pas sbyong ba'o// dang po lus kyis sems sbyong ba ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom par dkar po rdor dril 'dzin par bsgom/ 'di rmi lam yin par 'dug /rmi lam la ji ltar sbyar sbyang yin snyam du bsams nas g.yang sa lta bul bskyur bas 'od du yal song bar bsam mo// gnyis pa sems kyis lus sbyong ba ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i smin mtshams dang tshegs thams cad du yi ge hūm̐ sngon po re re bsgom/ de'i 'od kyis rang gi lus lha sku phyag rgya chen po gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du spyad// gsum pa bdag med mas sbyong ba ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i nor bu'i nang du hūm̐ dkar po mgo bo mthur du lta ba zhig bsam/ de la dmigs pa gtad de/ 'di rmi lam yin snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod pas hūm̐ de mgo bo gyen du log bas/

rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa zhig lus kyi nang du bde phri li li song nas 'od du zhu ste/ lus kyi nang thams cad 'od dkar pos gang bas mthar yal te song nas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag go /bzhi pa 'dun pas sbyong ba ni/ snod bcud phra rags ci mthong yang rmi lam du 'dug snyam du bsams nas/ rang gi lus phar thal tshul thal du sbyang*/ gsum pa rmi lam spel ba la gnyis te/ thug phrad du spel ba dang*/ gang 'dul du spel ba'o// dang po ni sa yi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te 'di rmi lam du 'dug /rmi lam gyi snang ba la gang spel spel yin snyam du bsams nas gcig las bcu/ bcu las brgya/ brgya las stong*/ stong las khri/ (165)de las 'bum la sogs pa blos 'khyud tshad du spel nas/ rim pa log ge bas bar snang gang ba tsam du bsgom mo// de'i 'og tu chu'i dkyil 'khor sngar ltar spel lo// de nas me'i dkyil 'khor/ rjes su rlung gi dkyil 'khor gong ltar spel lo// des mtshon te 'byung bzhi phra rags dang sems can phra rags gang mthong yang rmi lam du bsams nas gong ltar spel lo// gnyis pa gang 'dul du spel ba la gnyis te/ 'jig rten pa'i gang 'dul dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gang 'dul lo// dang po ni pha rol po 'bu lta bu la mang por spel nas/ rang bye'u mang por sprul nas bza' ba sogs kyis 'dul/ bye'u lta bu la rang khra lta bu sprul nas 'dul/ khyi la sbyang khyi/ spyang khyi la stag /stag la seng ge /mi la srin po la sogs rang la rang gi gnyen po de dang der sprul nas gsod pa dang bcing ba dang brdung ba la sogs pa bya ste 'dul lo// gnyis pa ni/ pha rol klu lta bu la rang bya khyung rgyal po dang*/ pe kar lta bu la rta mgrin/ klu bdud dang klu srin la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ gnod sbyin dang srin po lta bu la phyag na rdo rje gtum po sogs gdon de'i gnyen por bsngags pa'i khro bo sogs de dang der sprul nas 'dul ba dang khyur mid la bza' ba dang*/

phyag mtshan gyis gtubs pa dang me phung gis bsreg pa la sogs pa bya ste 'dul lo// bzhi pa rmi lam sprul pa la'ang des mtshon no// lnga pa rmi lam sgyur ba ni/ sa'i dkyil 'khor 'di chur bsgyur/ chu'i dkyil 'khor mer bsgyur/ me'i dkyil 'khor 'di rlung du bsgyur/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor de nam mkha' la yal song bar bsams nas de'i ngo bor blta'o// de ni snod kyi 'jig rten bsgyur ba'o// bcud kyi sems can bsgyur ba ni/ dmyal ba rnams yi dwags su bsgyur/ yi dwags rnams dud 'gror bsgyur/ dud 'gro rnams mir bsgyur/ mi rnams lha min tu bsgyur/ lha min lhar bsgyur/ (166)lha rnams phyag rgya chen por bsgyur/ yang lha nas dmyal ba'i bar yas mar bsgyur/ de bzhin du ma dag pa'i 'jig rten 'di yang dag pa'i zhing khams su bsgyur ba la sogs pa rmi lam la brtan pa thob par bya'o// de thams cad la'ang 'di rmi lam du 'dug rmi lam gyi snang ba la gang bsgyur bsgyur yin snyam du bsam pa gal che'o// drug pa yul snang blta ba ni lus gnad dang*/ sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra ba las/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lte ba'i 'og tu chos 'byung ngam/ thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bdud rtsis gang ba zhig bsam/ de nas rang gi sna bug g.yas nas tshur rdo rje bdag med ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa gar stabs can cig gis sna drangs nas yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa byon/ lte 'og nas bdud rtsi bzhes pas dgyes par bsam/ yi dam gyi lha khyed rnams kyis bdag gis yul snang gtan la phebs par mdzad du gsol/ snyam du bsams pas bdag med mas sna drangs nas sna bug g.yon nas phyir thon nas nam mkha' la bzhugs nas phyag gis brda mdzad nas/ thog mar dmyal ba'i gnas bstan/ de nas yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ mi/ lha ma yin/ lha yi gnas/ de nas bde ba can la sogs dag pa'i zhing khams bstan par bsam mo// de ltar nyin mtshan gnyis kar bsam zhing*/

yul snang gtan la nam phebs bar du bsgom/ skabs su snod bcud du snang ba de yi byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad bcad nas rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul du thag bcad/ sems kyi byung gnas 'gro gsum yang rtsad bcad nas mthar phyag rgya chen po snang stong zung 'jug gi ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /des na 'dir rab dmigs med gsal mkhyen/ 'bring gang bsam gsal mthong*/ tha ma yid lus mkha' lding*/ dman pa dmigs pa'i yul mthong ngo*// phyi ma la bdag med mas yul snang 'char byed/ as yul snang rang (167)gsal/ thig le yul snang gsal byed ces spros pa rnams ni 'di kho na nyams su blangs pas grub par yod do zab// /de dag gi skabs su 'khrul 'byams/ sad 'byams/ bde 'byams sogs kyi gegs byung na bla ma la mos gus byas nas gsol ba gtab/ yi dam chos skyong la tshogs 'khor dang gtor ma dang*/ gegs sel gyi dmigs pa rmog lcog pas mdzad pa'i 'byams gcod du ltos shig /bzhi pa 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam/ kha zas bcud can za/ spyod lam dal bar sdod/ thabs lam nan bskyed la bsgom/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams la tshogs 'khor gtor ma 'bul/ 'od gsal mos gus kyi gnad yin pas bla ma la gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi ste/ 'od gsal bzung ba/ lam du khyer ba/ bsre ba/ mthar thug gi 'od gsal lo// dang po la a la bzung ba ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom pa gsal ba'i snying gar a dkar po dri ma med pa 'od 'tsher ba zhig bsam/ de'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang gang*/ de nas rang gi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad dkar seng nge ba zhig bsgom la bzung ngo*// de la ma zin na rang bde mchog dkar por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i pad zla'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i 'khor lo sdom pa tshon gang ba'i thugs kar a dkar po nyungs 'bru tsam 'od 'phro ba zhig bsam/

de las 'od 'phros pas lus phyi nang thams cad dkar sing song*/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad dkar sing nge ba zhig tu bsgoms pas 'char ro// de la ma zin na thig le la bzung ba ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom pa tshon gang tsam du gsal ba'i smin mtshams thig le dkar po til (168)'bru tsam 'od 'phro ba zhig la sems rtse gcig tu gtad de/ yem yengs par bsgoms na 'char bar nges so// yang na bdag med mal bzung ba ni/ gong rmi lam gyi skabs su bshad pa'i klad rgya'i mtshams kyi bdag med ma nam mkha' la lding ba 'dra ba de bsgom zhing thod pa dung khang lta bur bsgoms pas zin no// lam khyer sogs phyi ma gsum ni 'od gsal shar na spros te bogs 'don dang bcas pa rnams rgyas par rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang khyung po'i bsdus don bzhin du bla ma gong ma'i khrid yig tu gsal zhing bla mas ngo sprad pas chog go /rjes la dam tshig la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung bas ma phog par bya zhing*/ bye brag tu 'od gsal la thig le ye shes kyi dwangs ma yin pas khams dkar po ba thag tsam yang ma nyams par bya'o// gzhan yang gegs sel bogs 'don 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin nyams rtogs dang nyin mtshan gyi khyad par sogs bla ma gong ma'i gsung sgros su gsal lo// 'di dag kyang ni gu mas/ 'od gsal 'char byed bla ma'i mos gus dang*// bde chen zag bcas zag med lta gding dang*// bde gsal mi rtog dbyer med rang shar 'byung*// sbyor dngos rjes gsum dus gnad brgyan par bya'o// zhes pa'i nyams len no// lnga pa 'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas ni/ ni gu mas// 'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba yang rab ste// 'bring dang tha mas chags sdang spang bya ste// dga' zhing mos gus dmigs pa rtse gcig gis// gyen du 'phangs shing smon lam brgyan par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i nyams len la/ rab lta thog nas 'pho ba/

'bring sgyu lus nas 'pho ba/ tha ma smon lam gyis 'pho ba'o// dang po ni/ 'pho bya 'pho byed bral ba'i rang sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ nam mkha' dwangs ba lta bu bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'o// 'di la chos sku de (169)bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba yang zer ro// gnyis pa dbang po 'bring sgyu lus kyi steng nas 'pho ba la/ yi dam la 'pho ba dang*/ bla ma la 'pho ba gnyis/ dang po la sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyor ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad nyi'i steng du yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa zhig shin tu gsal bar bsgom/ de la mchod pa 'bul/ yi dam dpal he ru ka bdag mkha' spyod kyi gnas su drang du gsol// ces gsol ba drag tu gdab/ he ru kas rigs kyi bu yar shog gsungs pa'i gnang ba byung bas rang gi sems 'od dkar po zhig tu gyur nas/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas yar song ste/ spyi gtsug nas rgyang thon/ yi dam yab yum gyi thugs kar thim/ de nas yi dam yab yum kyang 'og min gyi 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i thugs kar thim par bsam/ de'i thugs ka na a dkar po gcig yod pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad/ de nas a de 'od dkar po zhig tu song ste yas mar byung rang gi tshangs bug nas dbu ma'i nang na mar zhugs/ snying gar slebs pas a dkar po zhig tu song ba la sems gtad/ de ltar yang dang yang du sbyangs pas/ rab la spyi bo brdol nas khrag chu 'dzag pa 'ong*/ 'bring la spyi bo 'phrigs pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ tha ma la yang spyi bo za gul ba yong*/ de rnams 'byongs pa'i rtags yin no// de'i gnas skabs rnams su rnam shes thal srid pas/ spyi gtsug na rin po che'i snod kyis mnan/

des thub bo// gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ nam zhig 'chi ltas kyis phog pa'i tshe bla ma yi dam la tshogs dang gtor ma 'bul/ lus longs spyod nye 'brel la sogs pa yul yid du 'ong ba sogs (170)gsum la brten pa'i chags sdang rmongs gsum thams cad spangs la gong gi dmigs pa bzhin rtse gcig tu 'phos nas sems slar lus la mi ldog go /gnyis pa bla ma la 'pho ba la'ang gnyis las sbyang ba ni/ sngon 'gro gong dang 'dra/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa rgyan cha lugs rnams gong sgyu lus bzhin du bsgoms nas yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes yang yang brjod cing bdag mkha' spyod kyi gnas su drang du gsol/ bdag gis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas gong bzhin du gnang ba byung bas/ rang sems 'od dkar po zhig tu song ste rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas yar song*/ tshangs bug nas rgyang 'thon nas bla ma'i thugs kar thim pas bla ma yang 'od du yal nas mi rtog pa'i ngang du 'jog /yang na bla ma 'og min du 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs kar thim pa sogs sngar dang 'dra'o// las la sbyar ba'ang gong gi rigs pas shes dgos so// tha ma smon lam gyis 'pho ba ni/ gang zag tha mal pa dmigs pa mi chun pa rnams la ni 'chi ba'i tshe chags sdang spangs nas dag pa'i zhing du skye ba la sogs pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab cing sangs rgyas kyi mtshan byin rlabs can sgrog pa la sogs pa bya ba yin no// 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba ni zhal gdams zur du yod do// sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i 'pho ba'i man ngag*// drug pa bar do rgyal ba longs sku la/ spyir 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bar dor bsdus nas bshad na/ rang bzhin lhun grub kyi bar do/

ting 'dzin bsam gtan gyi bar do/ rnam smin skye shi'i bar do/ rmi lam bag chags kyi bar do/ lugs ldog 'chi kha'i bar do/ lugs 'byung srid pa'i bar do ste drug las/ 'dir sbyang bya'i (171)bar do gtso che ba skyes nas ma shi'i bar gyi skye shi bar do dang*/ gnyid du song nas ma sad kyi bar rmi lam bar do dang*/ shi nas skye ba phyi ma ma blangs bar gyi srid pa bar do gsum yin pa las/ dang po ni/ sbyong byed sgyu lus bsgoms pas sbyangs la/ gnyis pa ni sbyong byed rmi lam sbyong spel gyis sbyang bar bya'o// 'dir skabs su bab pa srid pa bar do sbyong ba'i tshul la ni gu mas// bar do snang sogs 'od gsal longs sku dang*// gang 'dul sprul sku mtshams sbyor skyo shas gnad// chags sdang phrag dog 'od gsal lha skus sbyang*// sgrib gnyis rang dag sku gsum mngon du 'gyur// gzugs sgra sa chu snang mched la sogs pa'i// thim 'gros rang bzhin brgyad cu shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i nyams len la/ da lta'i gnas skabs su srid pa bar do 'dun pas sbyang ba'i tshul dang*// 'chi ba 'od gsal shar nas bar do tshun chad du nyams su blangs nas 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ a tsa ma nga shi nas bar do na slebs 'dug /gdos bcas kyi lus med pas phyin pa'i shul la rkang rjes kyang mi 'dug /lus la khams dkar dmar med pas phyi rol du nyi zla'i 'od mi snang*/ rang gi grib ma'ang mi snang 'dug pa bar do na yod pa'i rtags yin/ nga la bla ma rin po ches bar do la bar do ngo shes par gyis la bar do rgyal ba longs skur nyams su long gsungs pa'i skabs der slebs 'dug pas re sa gzhan na med do// bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam du gsol ba gdab cing*/ rab kyis lta thog tu 'jog /'bring sgyu lus bsgom/ tha ma smon lam rnam par dag par gdab bo// yang skabs su nga shi nas bar do na slebs 'dug

/de'i rtags res 'ga' ram 'brog chen po skya ngam me ba dang*/ res 'ga' dmar ngam me ba dang*/ res 'ga' nag ngam me ba'i snang ba 'dug /'di bla ma'i gsung gis yang ba'i (172)gnas gsum yod gsungs pa der 'dug pas/ re sa gzhan na med sogs sngar bzhin bsgom/ yang skabs su nga bar do na 'dug /sa rlung log pas ri bo sogs grum pa'i sgra dang*/ de'i 'og tu 'chor ba'i snang ba dang*/ chu rlung log pas chu bo chen po'i sgra dang*/ des khyer ba'i snang ba 'byung*/ me rlung log pas nags mes tshig pa la sogs me'i sgra dang*/ des tshig pa 'dra ba'i snang ba 'byung*/ rlung gi rlung logs pa'i stobs kyis las kyi rlung chen po'i sgra dang*/ des khyer ba'i snang ba 'byung ba 'di bla mas bar dor 'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi 'byung gsungs pa der 'dug pas/ re sa gzhan na med do sogs gong bzhin bsgom/ yang skabs su nga shi nas bar do na 'dug /gnas ma nges pa res 'ga' lha khang dang*/ khang khyim la sogs pa'i snang ba 'char/ res 'ga' sa phug dang spyil po la sogs pa'i snang ba 'char/ grogs la nges pa med pa res 'ga' lha'i bu dang bu mo sogs yid du 'ong ba dang 'grogs/ res 'ga' 'dre dang srin po sogs yid du mi 'ong ba dang 'grogs pa'i snang ba 'char/ zas ma nges pa res 'ga' bdud rtsi dang res 'ga' mi gtsang ba sogs kyi dris tshims pa'i snang ba 'char/ gos ma nges pa res 'ga' re shags la sogs pa dang*/ res 'ga' dar zab la sogs gyon pa'i snang ba 'char/ snang ba ma nges pa da ltar rang rang gi /yul na yod pa la de ma thag gshed du yul gzhan du slebs pa'i snang ba 'char/ skyabs ma nges pa res 'ga' zam pa dang ngal stegs ljon shing la sogs pa la skyabs su 'gro ba'i snang ba 'char gin 'dug pas/ 'di bla mas bar dor ma nges pa'i rtags drug yod gsungs pa der 'dug pas/ re sa gzhan na med do zhes sogs gong bzhin bsgom/ gzhan yang nga shi nas bar do na slebs 'dug

/khar seng ngas nye du sogs la gtam lab dus gtam lan yod pa la da gtam lan mi khug 'dug /zas su'ang dri (173)za bar 'dug /ri bo sogs la'ang thogs med du phyin nas gang 'dod pa'i sa der yud tsam gyis sleb par 'dug ces sogs zas za ba gtam lab pa gos gyon pa sogs mdor na spyod lam bzhi po thams cad du a bar do na sleb 'dug ces sogs dang*/ re sa gzhan na med do bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen no zhes gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ de'i ngang nas rab kyis lta thog tu 'jog /'bring sgyu lus bsgom/ tha mas smon lam rnam dag gdab po// gnyis pa 'od gsal shar nas bar do tshun chad du nyams su blangs nas 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul la rab bar do dang po'i 'od gsal rang shar/ 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar/ tha ma sprul sku 'gags med rang shar/ spyi'i gnad 'chug med lam khyer ro// dang po ni rim gyis 'chi ba'i dbang du byas na/ dang po yul snang lnga thim pa'i tshul ni/ gzugs sgra la thim pas mig gis gzugs cung zad mi gsal du 'gro// sgra dri la thim pas rna bas sgra mi tshor/ dri ro la thim pas snas dri mi tshor/ ro reg bya la thim pas lces ro bcud mi tshor/ reg bya'i chos rlung la thim pas lus kyis reg bya rnams ji lta ba bzhin mi tshor zhing*/ lus kyi mdangs ngan du 'gro'o// 'byung ba thim tshul ni/ dang po sa chu la thim pas lus kyi stobs nyams/ kha chu dang sna chu 'dzag /chu me la thim pas lce dang kha sna sogs gsher ba'i cha thams cad skam/ me rlung la thim pas lus drod mtha' nas sdud/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyi nang gi dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad do// rnam shes 'od gsal la thim pas skad cig dang po'i skabs su khams dwangs ma dkar po chu'i rang bzhin spyi gtsug na yi ge haṃ gi rnam par gnas pa de thur du babs pas/ phyi rtags su zla ba shar ba lta bu dkar lam pa 'byung*/ nang rtags su du ba lta bu ban bun nam smrig rgyu lta bu lang lang 'od zer lnga dang (174)ldan pa 'phro ba 'byung*/

de'i dus su snang ba zhes pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig dang por 'char ro// de'i stobs kyis zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu so gsum po 'gags shing*/ de'i dus su dgra mi sha bo la yang zhe sdang skye ba 'byung*// de'i rjes su khams dwangs ma dmar po me'i rang bzhin lte ba na gtum mo a thung gi rnam par gnas pa de gyen la 'bar bas/ phyi rtags su nyi ma shar ba lta bu la/ nang rtags srin bu me khyer lta bu dmar chems pa 'byung*/ de'i dus su mched pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes sngar bas ches gsal la 'dzin pa med pa de la lhan ner gnas pa skad cig ma gnyis pa 'byung ste/ de'i stobs kyis 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags shing*/ de'i dus su lha'i bu dang bu mo la yang 'dod chags mi skye ba 'byung ngo*// dkar dmar gnyis po de dang por snying gar 'phrad pa'i bar du rlung sems gnyis tshug pa las/ phyi rtags su mun sros pa lta bu nag 'thibs pa yod/ nang rtags su mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu gsal la mi rtog pa sing ba zhig 'byung*/ de'i dus su thob pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gsal la 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral ba de la lhan ner gnas pa skad cig ma gsum pa 'byung ste/ de'i stobs kyis gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun po 'gag go /snying gar khams dkar dmar gnyis kyi bar du chug pa'i rlung sems dbu mar chud pa las/ phyi rtags tho rangs skya rengs shar ba lta bu skya lam pa zhig 'byung*/ nang rtags ston ka'i nam mkha' la nyi ma'i mdangs phog pa lta bu 'byung zhing*/ bde stong gi nyams 'char bar 'gyur ro// de'i dus su nye bar thob pa rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhes bya ba zhen rtog kyi dri ma thams cad dang bral ba bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes skad cig ma bzhi pa 'byung zhing*/

ye (175)shes des rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog phra rags kyi cha dang bcas pa thams cad 'od gsal la thim par 'gyur ro// 'di la rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhes kyang bya/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'i pho brang zhes kyang bya/ bar do dang po 'od gsal rang shar zhes kyang bya zhing*/ sngar 'od gsal 'dris yod pa'i gang zag dbang po rab rnams kyis rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal de dang*/ slar bsgoms pa'i 'od gsal gnyis ma bu 'phrod nas 'od gsal de nyid ngos bzung ste/ de'i ngang du rtse gcig tu gnas pas srid pa bar dor 'jug mi dgos par chos skur 'tshang rgya zhing*/ chos sku skya med de las ma g.yos bzhin gzugs sku gnyis rang shar lhun grub tu 'byung nas des 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du/ gang la gang 'dul gyis sems can smin grol la 'god par byed do// ye shes rol pa'i rgyud las// 'od gsal zin pa'i gang zag la// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// gzhan don gzugs sku'i snang ba 'char// dper na yid bzhin nor bu 'dra// zhes gsungs so// de ni rim gyis pa'i dbang du byas pa gtso che ba tsam yin/ cig char ba la de 'dra ba'i rim pa'i nges pa med/ skyes bu tha mal pa 'chi ba'i 'byung ba sogs thim tshul dang*/ rnal 'byor pas bsgoms pa'i nyams 'char tshul 'dra bas/ du ba dang smrig rgyu sogs dang por 'byung ba'i nges pa med do// mdor na rgyal bas mdo rgyud las gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma sgom pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gsung dang*/ rang gis bsgoms pa'i myong ba gsum po mthun dgos kyis/ go yul dang myong ba so sor song na gyod byed cing*/ pho tshod tshabs su 'gro ba dka' bas chos par khas 'che ba tsho gzab dgos so// gnyis pa 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar ni/ dbang po 'bring la bar do dang po'i 'od gsal la gnas par ma nus pa'i gang zag (176)gis srid pa bar dor 'jug dgos shing*/

de'i bdun phrag dang po la longs sku thob pa'i phyir du 'bad dgos so// de la bdun phrag dang po'i zhag phyed dang bzhi tshun chad la skye ba snga ma'i lus/ yul/ khyim/ nor rdzas/ nye 'brel sogs kyi snang ba 'char bas/ dus der bar dor shes pa 'byung dka'/ de nas zhag phyed dang bzhi song nas phyi ma'i lus kyi snang ba yud tsam re shar nas snga ma'i lus snang des rtag ma thub pa dang*/ bkres skom sogs kyi sdug bsngal gyis nyen nas snga ma'i nye 'brel rnams kyi rtsar phyin nas zas skom blangs pas/ zas skom ster ba lta zhog gtam lan tsam yang mi smra bar rang gi ming nas 'bod cing mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa mthong nas a pa nga shi 'dug snyam du ngo shes pa 'byung*/ de'i tshe bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas bar do la bar dor ngo shes par gyis la rgyal ba longs sku nyams su long zhig gsungs pa'i dus der sleb 'dug snyam du shes pa sngar goms pa'i stobs kyis 'byung zhing de'i tshe bar do rgyal ba longs skur sangs rgyas pas chog /re dga' snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pas bla ma la gsol ba btab nas bar do'i snang ba thams cad rang gi sems snang yin/ rang gi sems snang thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam yin snyam du bsams nas/ rang yi dam lha/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mor bsgyur cing bsgoms pas sngar bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis/ rang rgyal ba longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde la zhen pa med pa'i lha sku/ chos sku'i ngo bo// longs sku'i rnam pa/ sprul sku'i phrin las/ de gsum dbyer med pa'i bde ba chen po'i skur rang shar du 'byung ste/ des 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyis smin grol la 'god par byed do// sngar bsgoms pa zhig yin na de'i stobs kyis bar do'i (177)shes pa de da lta bas shes pa sum bcu 'gyur gyis gsal bas sangs mi rgya mi srid pas the tshom ma byed par sgoms shig

/bdun phrag dang por sangs ma rgyas na sngar bsgoms pa'i stobs chen po med pa dang*/ dbang po yang tha mar song ba yin pas/ gsum pa dbang po tha mas sprul sku 'gags med rang shar ni zhag bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du bar dor gnas srid pas/ de la nga shi nas bar do na 'dug snyam pa'i sdug bsngal chen po 'byung zhing*/ de'i rjes la pha ma dang pho mo sogs la dmigs pa'i 'dod chags skyes nas de la brten pa'i phrag dog dang mig ser skye/ des mtshams sbyar nas 'khor bar skye ba len par 'gyur bas/ de la nga shi 'dug snyam pa'i dus der/ kye ma chags sdang skyes na de'i dbang gis 'khor bar skye ba len par 'gyur zhing des sdug bsngal bas/ da ni bde chen gyi zhing du mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya'o snyam pa dang*/ bar do'i snang ba thams cad bden med sgyu ma yin snyam du bsam zhing bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang gi mdun du chos 'byung mthing nag gcig gi nang du rang sems hūm̐ sngon por gyur par bsam/ de las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa 'phros pas/ 'gro ba lnga'i bag chags dang dri ma sbyangs/ mngal sgo bkag par bsam mo// de nas hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las rang sems yi dam yab yum du bsgom/ bar do'i chags sdang gi yul pho mor snang ba de yang yi dam yab yum du bsgoms nas/ mchod pa 'bul zhing gsol ba btab/ sgra grags tshad sngags/ dran rtog thams cad lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du skad cig yud tsam mnyam par bzhag par/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad dang rang lus snang stong zhen bral gyi sprul sku'i snang ba 'ba' zhig rang shar du byung nas/ dus de nyid du 'tshang mi rgya mi srid do// bzhi pa spyi gnad 'chug med lam khyer ni/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum ka'i skabs su bar do skyo (178)shas kyi gnad yin pas bar do'i dran 'dun dang*/ skyo shas drag po skyed cing bla ma la gsol ba gdab/
